name: FACEF*CK
source: FACEF*CK is exactly what it says on the tin, a responsively animated simulation where you f*ck a guy's face until he gets into it. (This is, of course, a pre-negotiated and fully consensual fantasy roleplay scenario.)
translation: 《FACEF*CK》名副其实，是一款带有实时动态反馈的模拟游戏——你将对着一名男子的脸尽情抽插，直到他也彻底沉沦其中。（当然，这一切都是事先协商妥当、双方完全自愿的幻想角色扮演情境。）
